claims.claim: Reviewers report that the PvE game mode is level-locked and cannot be accessed until reaching higher levels such as 12 or 20.

citations.review_text:
What I write for this review is the experience I had with the game, everybody will experience things differently. This is my honest review if you don't like it well tough. Also no game is safe from a review whether it's early access or full release, now onto the review.

Arena Breakout: Infinite is a PvEvP extraction game basically you go into a open world-ish map, loot & try to leave. You will encounter AI enemies & real players in the map. I'll be honest I only downloaded this because there were suppose to be PvE only modes & yet the game level locks them. The first one is at level 12 & it took me two games to get to level 3. With leveling up, experience gain gets slower, that common so it should be about 15-30 runs to get to level 12 just for PvE. My 95mins of PvP playtime I just though "wow this is literally Delta Force just no abilities". 

On top of that my second run I encountered a cheater, who was obviously wall hacking. I didnt see a new player protection system so a new player can get slaughtered by a skilled player very easily. AI enemies seem to have insane hearing, tries to shoot you through a wall or just be alerted even though they are not facing you while you are crouched, slow moving. Searching is dumb, you do  a search of how many items there are than start searching what the items are. Default ads is press instead of hold. Ammo mag check is alt+t which is uncomfortable to press. 

This game clearly isnt all play type focused, it forces PvP over PvE. which is what people like me want to play. So with all that Arena Breakout: Infinite is a 5/10 making an average PvE extraction game. 

That's the Pony review

I actually played it back in the days without Steam, but it was horrible at the beginning. Now after a lot of patches and a PVE mode, I wanted to give it another try and yeah well.
I must say, the hit-registrations feels very nice, shots actually go there where you aim. I understand, new accounts should get teached all the feature and things you can do but jesus, I got more pop-ups with tips then on p hub. But if it's helpful for the beginners, why not, you only get it once (I hope). 
All the QoL changes they did since I played the last time, are actually great. Just an example, I played back in the days when you didn't see the value of a item in the raid :)
Somehow after the trainings raid you get told to queue and join and all of the sudden, I am against other players. Don't get me wrong, it is mainly a PVP game, but there was no warning or anything lol But yeah, killed a team of 2 that were extract camping (fu both).
Then I wanted to check out the "new" PVE mode and you need to be above lvl 20 or 25 to be able to get in there, something with tickets? Why so complicated, just add a map and it says in the overview "PVE". Easy or you could even add a toggle to each map PVP/PVE. Or if you are scared because of the inflation of the PVP items, create a different game mode and separate it.
Anyways, performance was alright, I actually reached 144 with my setup.
Maybe I will change it in the future once they fix that chaos with the PVE mode.
unfortunately Pve is not available until level 12 and since i dont enjoy pvp at all its not something id recommend for similar minded people who enjoy pve but no pvp

TLDR if you're looking for a extraction shooter you can play just PvE in the mode doesn't unlock till level 12

I'm sure its a great game when you develop into it but I downloaded the game, loaded into the main menu, saw the PvE mode is locked behind level 12, instant uninstall, I'm sure many people love PvP extract shooters, but when is someone going to develop the PvE shooter. "well there would be too much gear" THATS THE FUN, when you have lots of gear then you don't mind playing PvP because if you like fighting you don't have to worry that its your one chance to use the nice gun then lose it. Hell even if it was a seperate game entirely, but I really dislike this idea that these games can only be fun in PvPvE modes. Now I could be different from the fan base this game is looking for. I don't want gear to be rare, I don't want gear fear, but I want the feel of an extraction shooter. I don't understand the fun of wasting time losing gear. But for you this might be great.

citations.review_text: This game is what happens if you imagine exactly what tarkov is, but every part of what makes tarkov bad is now good, i.e in tarkov, no map, no team ui, way too confusing methods to get ammo for guns, boring maps, (mind u there are scp like entities in certain maps, its awesome). not only that, but the game is free! sure micro transations out the wazoo, but honestly for a better exsperience than tarkov while not making me spend 40 dollars, its excellent

this game is really good for a free game and you can get almost everthing for free exept for the packs that cost money those i havent found a way that you can get them for free it also looks great even with my pc being a little below optimal for a ton of new gen games but this game is one of the best ive seen so far including hell divers 2

This game has a very good base to work off of, the load times are ridiculously fast and the gunplay is very smooth. The operators are supposed to be the players however they try and make fool people by filling your empty lobbies with AI operators instead of just leaving them empty. This gives you the good feelings of killing players until you realise that they are just a different flavour of bot, I knew something was up when my South African servers of a pretty unknown game were just filled with low level awful players.

Also amount of UI that pops up is unreasonable, battle pass here, loot box system there, microtransactions with premium currency filling the gaps. It's just so painful overall.

A good idea turned into a slop fest.

Thought this game could be really good at first. Found it was full of Chinese cheaters. Not only that, its made by a Chinese company that directly ported it from a mobile game. Its literally a mobile game that was ported to PC as a cash grab. P2W, full of cheaters and owned by the largest Chinese company that uses AI to quite literally make everything they touch. They must've copied the mobile game's hitreg because its nonexistent, combined with bottom of the barrel 20 tick servers. And its supposed to be a "tactical" extraction shooter. Everybody just sprints around jumping and shooting with no accuracy penalty. Its COD style gunplay but somehow worse and disguised as an "ultra-tactical, hardcore, extraction shooter." Lmfao. What a joke. How this game has any good reviews is beyond me. The in-game economy is one of the worst i've seen out of any extraction shooter, the gear, the weaponry, its all either locked behind P2W or you have to spend an insane amount of in game currency to compete in the slightest. Armor below T6 is like getting shot through a trash bag. Shooting any ammo below gold tier is like shooting a BB gun. Genuinely a horrible game that tried to rip off EFT but used way too much AI generation to do it. China and TenCent can go ♥♥♥♥ themselves.
meh game really, full of skins and bs, it was better before all of them

Matchmaking system is a serious problem
player play for 3k match and retreat with 1 billion+ worth item will match with player play for 1 day,i shoot by him by gold bullet.......

I check back every season, and nothing changes - it just gets worse: premade squads of tryhards dominate the whole map, while matchmaking dumps you solo against a full T6 team (literally, there were only five people on the map).

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the matchmaking as placing solo players into matches against pre-made squads and against opponents with significantly better gear and higher ranks.

citations.review_text:
Very cool game. Unfortunately, I have to leave a negative review for several reasons.
-As a new player you get matches against max level - high-ranked players even on the first basic normal difficulty map.
- You get matched against groups as a solo player while the above statement is also included. ( example:1 level 15 vs 2 max level high ranked players)
- Almost everyone is using “Gold” ammo.
- Armor is useless vs “Gold” ammo.
- Way too many headshots while players “spray and pray”
- Sound is kinda overtuned. You can hear movement from way too far. 
- Maybe there is a small number of cheaters. but is very hard to tell for sure.
- You can list a very small number of items on the market.
- “Safe pocket” case is way too small , having a bigger one requires a subscription.
I could list some more issues but the first 4 alone are enough.

They need too change the way the matchmaking works on this game because all my friends do not own PCS so i am stuck winging it every single match. heres something that really made my experience probably the worst is why did I grind too level 30 to only find out that i can not play every map as a solo op?  and why would you make the entry cost 50k every time i wanna load in? you guys are very neglectful towards your solo players looking for a fun raiding experience. 
P.S CHEATERS RUIN GAMES please for the love of god add some sort of anti cheat too get rid of these guys in the 87 raids i had in the 40 hours i played i ran into 44 hackers people using speed hacks people spin botting people auto aiming on me through 5 feet of concrete.so please fix your matchmaking and add an anticheat even something as simple as changing your BIOS on your computer too detect it would work but as of now i will not be playing this is the near future

even delta force realized this issue and put restrictions in place. if you are new player, just look away. play something else.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that AI scavs can detect player positions through cover, smoke, and walls, and react aggressively by tracking them across the terrain.

citations.review_text: Current season i dont know what they did to ai player bots but there is so many i had a firefight with 8 fake players spraying there entire guns with two assult rifle trying to shoot through walls ....

Imagine trying to "balance" the game by making pistol calibres more effective than literal rifle rounds at distance. It makes no sense at all that i can mag dump bots in the face, neck, shoulders, and torso with rounds only one level of penetration higher than their respective armour. It shows that these devs have no idea how ballistics actually work and it is infuriating that a scav can immediately detect my location by proximity alone, even while im sneaking and ratting around. Not to mention killing *any* scav causes a spawn wave that sends an additional 4-8 of them out of the air to aimbot you through bushes and cover. This company doesn't value fun or entertainment. The game is an egregious example of artificial difficulty amongst various issues I've noticed being brought up by the community as a whole. 
The single most bs thing ive noticed is that 9x19 can outgun a mosin with level 6 penetration ammo at over 150 metres with a damn uzi. How the hell can you justify this? This game has arguably worse mechanics than EFT and it stands as an example of why i am no longer playing extraction shooters. The genre is plagued by companies like this that do not care enough to make a cohesive *and* fun experience. Until these problems are fixed, I am no longer interested in playing a sub-par experience even if it is free.

(English version available below) / (Английская версия ниже).

⚙️ Трезвый взгляд на ABI после 2000 часов в Таркове. Стоит ли играть? Cмог ли китайский гигант Tencent сделать убийцу главного экстракшен-шутера?

Если коротко: Нет, не убил. Но заставил Буянова попотеть.
Ниже разложу по полочкам, почему ABI - это одновременно глоток свежего воздуха и спорный продукт.

🟢 Что реально порадовало
+ Запуск за секунды. Загрузка в рейд идет секунд 30. Умер? Через минуту ты уже снова на карте в полной экипировке. Никаких «Ожиданий игроков» по 10 минут.
+ Игра не превращается в работу. Сюда не нужно заходить как на вторую смену. Захотел пострелять - зашел, кайфанул часик и спокойно вышел. Никакой обязаловки.
+ Нет тупых квестов. Нас избавили от маразма в духе «убей 15 ЧВК в прыжке с завязанными глазами». И главное - никаких квестов, которые тебя заставляют уныло перепроходить после каждого вайпа.
+ Читеров намного меньше. По моим ощущениям, в разы. Да, софтеры бывают везде, но тут они не встречаются в каждом втором рейде.
+ Античит работает на вас. Если вас всё-таки убил читер и его потом забанили - игра возвращает вам весь потерянный лут. Вот за это прям огромный респект разработчикам.
+ Игра не тормозит. Оптимизация на удивление отличная. FPS стабильный, картинка сочная, фризов в перестрелках нет.
+ Удобно играть. Человеческий интерфейс, понятная карта прямо в игре, нормальные маркеры. Не нужно держать открытой Википедию на втором мониторе, чтобы понять, куда идти.

🔴 Что напрягает
- Донат. Да, игра бесплатная, но Tencent хочет денег. Валюту можно купить за реал, а безопасный контейнер дают только по платной подписке. Без доната на высоких уровнях копить деньги на топовый шмот будет тяжело.
- Тесные карты. Локации довольно зажатые, из-за чего ПвП часто начинается в первые 20 секунд после спавна. Вас просто зажимают с двух сторон.
- Меньше атмосферы. Игра ощущается как стерильный хардкорный шутер в стиле Call of Duty. Тут нет того подкожного страха и безысход…

I LOVE THIS GAME, IBS for the win!
All seriousness very good, better than tarkov and I have 6,000 hours in tarkov. The m0vm3nt feels SlIcKeR, and streamlined, like tarkov pre-inertia update. Bakeez would approve. Also good gun selection 10/10.

AND Since it runs on unreal 5, unlike tarkov you can game at high settings, no stutters and its super optimized and looks just as good in my opinion.

Ignore the negative reviews; this game absolutely blew me away. If you are a fan of Tarkov, but you want something that is free, extremely generous, and has amazing QoL features that Nikita will never add, download it right now and load up a raid.

Pros:
Graphics are great, gameplay feels fluid, well optimized with max FPS, very fair cheating report system that rewards players similar to CS:GO Overwatch, models are great, gun variety is astonishing (they have a grease gun and MP40), the ranking system is fair, the game rewards you with free stuff constantly (including premium currency). Raids are easy at first, but once you hit a higher level you will find out soon that it's competitive. The camos and skins vary from serious grounded skins to goofy skins, which for some reason don't bother me at all. Market is streamlined, tons of events, easy controls, great animations for every item and reload, a fun rarity collection option, hideout implemented, quick kits for free, money is almost never an issue, high stakes maps like the labs equivalent—Tarkov++++ QoL features.

Cons:
Translations can be bad at times. Some guns are absolutely atrocious.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the anti-cheat system is ineffective and relies heavily on player reports, which can result in innocent players receiving automated temporary bans when reported out of spite.

citations.review_text:
After about 500hrs in the game (first 200 hours were from before it was added to steam), I can comfortably say that I enjoy this game. 

Whether you’re running meta gear, messing around with leg meta, or using a sniper; the PVP can be rewarding and satisfying.

What isn’t enjoyable is the dog a$$ customer service. After receiving a 1 day temporary ban after I died in raid, I was confused as to why and took my concerns to the customer support page. 

What did that get me? Absolutely nothing. Generic computer slop telling me that I have abnormal gaming behavior, and that I should trust the security team and that the strictness of these bans are to protect “dedicated players”. (I guess I don’t count as that)

Don’t get me wrong. Having a report system work and is able to quickly ban people who are actively cheating, breaking rules griefing 
 is awesome. What isn’t awesome is killing multiple doofus’s throughout various raids and having them rage report you out of spite, and receiving temporary bans in return.

After some quick google searches it turns out many people (whether they’re streamers or casuals) have been having this issue more and more over the last 6 months.

Arena Breakout: Infinite penalizes skilled players while ignoring actual issues. The anti-cheat heavily relies on player mass reports—meaning if you beat a squad and they get salty, you get slapped with an automated temp ban for "abnormal gameplay." Support uses copy-paste bot answers and refuses to check match logs or video evidence. Combined with heavy monthly microtransactions, it’s not worth your time or money.

This game started as a realistic shooter, and everything about it looked great. The skins, the events, the overall aesthetic—everything felt mature and well-designed.

But now? They’re selling skins with women in underwear in a combat zone. They’re adding skins with ridiculous things like watermelons on guns. Now we have an event with Bubble guns? Are you freaking serious now?!

The game is going down the same path as COD. Instead of fixing its RNG system and existing bugs, they seem more focused on making money by selling half-naked or ridiculous skins.

penetration is RNG-based in this game, which is extremely frustrating, especially when you’re using higher-tier armor and ammunition.

And don’t even get me started on the cheaters.

The game is full of cheaters in Forbidden and Solo Ops modes. Even when you report them and they somehow get caught (1 out of 10 get caught), they often receive only a 30-day ban or less.

And the funniest part? It feels like if someone has spent money on the game, they can get away with almost anything. No matter how obvious their cheating is, they don’t seem to get banned.

I started playing ABI in the middle of S1, and it felt like a realistic extraction shooter.  Unfortunately, every new season pushes it further away from that identity.

The matchmaking is terrible: T6 players with thermals are regularly paired against players running budget kits.  Gun balance has also become a mess!  Fights no longer feel realistic; it often takes entire magazines to down someone, while weapons that should be devastating (like the Mosin) can require multiple headshots just to do meaningful damage.  The game increasingly feels like an arcade shooter rather than a tactical extraction game.

Cheating is another huge problem.  Most cheaters receive only temporary bans, return quickly, and players who lose expensive gear get no compensation or rollback.

The monetization is also hard to justify.  The game is free, but many cosmetic bundles are around $100+, and instead of military-themed gear, the game is filled with anime, cyberpunk, fantasy armor, swords and other unrealistic cosmetics.

Honestly, the only consistently impressive part of ABI is the graphics, if you have a powerful enough PC to run it.  Every update makes the game heavier and more demanding while the gameplay quality keeps declining.


Rating: 2/10 - great graphics, but poor matchmaking, bad weapon balance, rampant cheating, and a complete loss of the realistic atmosphere that made the game popular in the first place.

[b]Played since Season 0 beta. 700+ Steam hours, 1,000+ hours actually in raids.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[b]BLUF: ABI used to reward multiple playstyles and tactical decision-making. MoreFun has steadily nerfed those options while rewarding meta gear, 4-man squads, arcade movement, and RNG-heavy combat. The game isn't harder; it's less consistent, less tactical, and simply less fun.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

I can't recommend ABI anymore. It started as a great middle ground between Tarkov-level tediousness and an arcade shooter. Positioning, patience, map knowledge, equipment, sound, aim, and knowing when to fight all mattered. MoreFun keeps "improving" that game into something worse.

The biggest problem is that the number of viable ways to play keeps shrinking. Range and sniping have been repeatedly nerfed, high-tier ammo gets more restrictions, headshot lethality is not predictable, while aggressive movement, jumping, and hip-fire are rewarded. Now the answer to damn near everything is four people in meta kits W-keying across the map.

A coordinated four-man should have a huge advantage. Better players should win fights. I don't want that changed. But a solo used to have concealment and positioning. A sniper had range. An ambush had surprise. Map knowledge, patience, and good equipment could offset other disadvantages. Those different advantages interacting are what made ABI interesting.

The armor and ammo system is a perfect example of the problem. I've repeatedly been one-tapped inside 20m through a T4 face shield by T5 BS from an AK-12. Fine. T4 glass shouldn't magically stop BS. But I've also repeatedly put BS through the same T4 mask at the same range and watched the other guy survive with 2 head HP.

I've also been one-tapped through a full-durability T6 Moto by T5 M62. T6 shouldn't make anyone immortal either. The problem is putting those outcomes together. T5 can punch pristine T6 and instantly kill, while T5 can penetrate T4 at close range and leave 2 hea…
